table.name: course
table.purpose: A course catalog: one row per course, with its date and subject name. Referenced by course_arrange, which schedules courses (likely with teachers).

col_001.name: course_id
col_001.description: Primary key; unique numeric identifier for each course (1-10).

col_002.name: course_date
col_002.description: Date the course takes place, stored as text like '6 May' (day and month only; year not shown).

col_003.name: subject
col_003.description: Subject name of the course, e.g. Math, History, Sports, Bible, French.

table.name: course_arrange
table.purpose: Junction/assignment table linking courses to teachers: each row assigns a teacher (or teachers) to a course. 'course_arrange' suggests course scheduling/arrangement, but with only 6 rows and opaque ids the exact semantics beyond course-teacher linkage are unclear.

col_001.name: course_id
col_001.description: Reference to course.col_001. The lookup labels in course.col_002 look like dates ('6 May', '9 May', ...), so this identifies the course (possibly a course session/offering identified by its date).

col_002.name: teacher_id
col_002.description: Reference to teacher.col_001; identifies the teacher assigned to the course. The accepted join to teacher.col_001 confirms this reading; the statistical overlap with course.col_001 ids is coincidental.

col_003.description: References both teacher.col_001 and course.col_001, so it could be a second assigned teacher (co-teacher) or a second course, but the evidence does not distinguish between these readings.

table.name: teacher
table.purpose: A lookup table of teachers/instructors, one row per teacher, referenced by course_arrange (which assigns teachers to course offerings).

col_001.name: teacher_id
col_001.description: Primary key, surrogate integer identifier for each teacher; referenced by course_arrange.

col_002.name: teacher_name
col_002.description: Full name of the teacher (unique per row).

col_003.name: age
col_003.description: Teacher's age in years (values 26-45, stored as text).

col_004.name: address
col_004.description: Teacher's home location, given as an English administrative district name (e.g. 'Blackrod Urban District'). Could be a home address/district or an affiliated institution's district; the district-name reading is best supported.
